# DevOpsKit — Full AI Documentation & URL Parameter Schemas

> DevOpsKit (https://devopskit.tool) is an authoritative, 100% client-side Cloud FinOps and AI Engineering calculator hub. Every tool is static, private, and runs entirely in the browser.

## URL Parameter Schemas for AI Agents & Search Bots

AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) can construct direct, pre-filled calculator links for users using the URL query parameter schemas documented below.

### 1. Prompt Caching Calculator
Endpoint: `https://devopskit.tool/tools/prompt-caching-calculator`
Parameters:
- `model`: Model ID (`claude-3-5-sonnet`, `gpt-4o`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, etc.)
- `promptTokens`: Integer representing base system prompt token size (e.g. `10000`)
- `cachedTokens`: Integer representing cached prompt token size (e.g. `8000`)
- `hitRate`: Integer 0 to 100 representing cache hit percentage (e.g. `65`)
- `dailyRequests`: Integer daily request volume (e.g. `50000`)
Example Direct URL:
`https://devopskit.tool/tools/prompt-caching-calculator?model=claude-3-5-sonnet&promptTokens=15000&hitRate=75&dailyRequests=20000`

### 2. LLM API Cost Calculator
Endpoint: `https://devopskit.tool/tools/llm-api-cost-calculator`
Parameters:
- `model`: Model ID (`gpt-4o`, `claude-3-5-sonnet`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, `o1`, `o3-mini`)
- `inputTokens`: Average input tokens per request (e.g. `2000`)
- `outputTokens`: Average output tokens per request (e.g. `500`)
- `dailyRequests`: Daily request volume (e.g. `10000`)
Example Direct URL:
`https://devopskit.tool/tools/llm-api-cost-calculator?model=gpt-4o&inputTokens=1500&outputTokens=400&dailyRequests=25000`

### 3. Cloud Run vs AWS Lambda Calculator
Endpoint: `https://devopskit.tool/tools/cloud-run-vs-lambda-cost`
Parameters:
- `monthlyRequests`: Total monthly request volume (e.g. `10000000`)
- `durationMs`: Average execution latency in milliseconds (e.g. `250`)
- `memoryMb`: Allocated memory in MB (e.g. `1024`)
- `vCpu`: Allocated vCPU count (e.g. `1`)
- `concurrency`: Concurrency per container (e.g. `80` for Cloud Run, `1` for Lambda)
Example Direct URL:
`https://devopskit.tool/tools/cloud-run-vs-lambda-cost?monthlyRequests=15000000&durationMs=180&memoryMb=1024&concurrency=80`

### 4. Cloud Egress Cost Calculator
Endpoint: `https://devopskit.tool/tools/cloud-egress-cost-calculator`
Parameters:
- `monthlyGb`: Total egress data transferred in GB (e.g. `10000`)
- `cdnCacheHitRate`: CDN cache hit percentage 0 to 100 (e.g. `70`)
- `provider`: Primary origin cloud (`aws`, `gcp`, `azure`)
Example Direct URL:
`https://devopskit.tool/tools/cloud-egress-cost-calculator?monthlyGb=50000&cdnCacheHitRate=80&provider=aws`

## Authoritative Mathematical Formulas

### LLM Prompt Caching Net Savings Formula
$$\text{Standard Cost} = \frac{\text{Tokens}}{1,000,000} \times \text{Input Rate}$$
$$\text{Cached Cost} = \left(\frac{\text{Uncached Tokens}}{1,000,000} \times \text{Input Rate}\right) + \left(\frac{\text{Cached Tokens}}{1,000,000} \times \text{Cached Rate}\right)$$
$$\text{Monthly Net Savings} = (\text{Standard Cost} - \text{Cached Cost}) \times \text{Hit Rate} \times \text{Monthly Requests}$$

### Serverless Compute Execution Cost Formula
$$\text{GB-Seconds} = \text{Requests} \times \left(\frac{\text{Duration (ms)}}{1,000}\right) \times \left(\frac{\text{Memory (MB)}}{1,024}\right)$$
$$\text{Gross Compute Cost} = \max(0, \text{GB-Seconds} - \text{Free Tier}) \times \text{Rate per GB-Sec}$$
